facts.summary: Filed Chapter 11 bankruptcy and agreed to sell Zokinvy to Sentynl · n/a · Zokinvy (lonafarnib) in progeria · on market

evidence.summary: Eiger BioPharmaceuticals, Inc. (Nasdaq:EIGR) today announced that it and its direct subsidiaries have filed voluntary petitions for chapter 11 protection under the United States Bankruptcy Code
evidence.program_discontinued: The company intends to sell substantially all of its assets during the bankruptcy case and to facilitate an orderly wind down of its operations.
